title: Custom Transformer LLM
summary: Implemented a Transformer from the paper level up—embedding layers, multi-head attention, encoder/decoder stacks, and a training loop with the right regularizers—so I could demystify how modern LLMs actually work. The project includes a clean data pipeline, labeled smoothing, early stopping, and search-time decoding to make results comparable across runs.

title: YouTube Data Analysis ELT Pipeline
summary: Built an ELT workflow on AWS to pull trending video data at scale, normalize it into efficient columnar files, and expose it for ad-hoc analysis. The aim was to separate collection, transformation, and querying so each piece could scale independently and stay cheap. Dashboards on top highlight regional trends and engagement patterns.

title: Chest Cancer Classification
summary: Created an end-to-end CNN pipeline for medical imaging—from dataset handling to experiment tracking—so model results are reproducible and comparable. The emphasis was on disciplined iteration: version the data, log the runs, and only change one thing at a time. This mindset made it possible to reason about improvements instead of guessing.
